prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished finished gameplay UI screenshot for original PC narrative adventure 《来自月亮的 Z》, landscape 16:9. Use reference image 1 (06-private-dialogue) for the definitive lateral 2.5D game staging, small adult character proportions and unobtrusive dialogue UI. Use reference image 2 (island-map-v2) for the cohesive painterly palette and simplified material finish ONLY, not its bird's-eye camera. Designed rock/wood planes, grouped pine silhouettes, subtle hand-painted surfaces, blue-violet coastal atmosphere, warm amber practical lights, ivory Chinese typography, coral active interaction, translucent charcoal surfaces with delicate imperfect outlines. Premium painterly game art, not photoreal, not miniature 3D, not anime portraits. Small adult characters ~18-23% screen height. Consistent protagonist: adult brown-haired man, rust-orange jacket, dark trousers, visible small stage-crew lanyard. Readable layered horizontal traversable environment with clear ground plane. No panels over faces. UI is quiet and spatial, not a dashboard, not an e-commerce website. Use high-quality perfectly readable Simplified Chinese sans typography, no gibberish or unnecessary English. Plenty of negative space around all text; generous margins. No health bars, awakening/trust stats, omniscient safety meters, portrait cards, or marketing headings.
SUBJECT: Prop room, a daytime place to talk with Z. NEW indoor lateral 2.5D environment, intimate quiet backstage room attached to the live-broadcast hall. Tall left windows admit cool BLUE DAYLIGHT and broad soft shafts of sunlight onto wood floor; the sea and distant pines are visible outside. Some warm amber task lamps. Rich but organized silhouettes of shelves, folded stage cloth, a coiled cable, old theatre props, a wooden table with cue sheets, a simple rack of costumes to the right. Do not overcrowd with little objects. A doorway toward rehearsal space at far right lets in a little cool light. Strong material grouping and calm composition. Keep center floor space open.
Only TWO adults, facing each other mid-frame: consistent protagonist in rust-orange jacket on left; Z on right, adult woman with chin-length straight ink-black bob, ivory jacket/cardigan over navy top and long muted-blue skirt, same as reference 1. They stand by a prop worktable, relaxed conversational pose, hands anatomically natural. No giant close-up portraits, no romantic hearts, no crowd.
Top-left exact text:
“第 5 日 · 休息时段”
“道具间”
Top-right unobtrusive contextual line “排练尚未开始”
Main Z dialogue bubble near and above her, clearly pointing to her, warm-white text on a thin charcoal speech shape:
small speaker label “Z”
“你想问灯塔的事？”
“趁排练还没开始，说吧。”
Two floating protagonist response choices, keep away from faces and Z's bubble. First selected coral:
“我发现了这份演出单。”
Second quiet outlined warm white:
“先聊聊你记得的灯塔。”
Bottom-left one small paper icon and a compact evidence interaction:
“可出示材料”
“演出单”
“E  出示”
Bottom-center airy underlined free-text input across about 35% screen width with a warm-white cursor, clear placeholder:
“也可以直接对 Z 说……”
small return key icon at its right and “发送”
Bottom-right “Esc  结束交谈”.
No other text. No relationship meter, no automatic agreement, no claim this room is permanently safe. This screen should communicate free daytime conversation PLUS ability to refer to concrete evidence, while preserving Z as a physically present character with agency. The warm room and cool daylight make this distinctly daytime, unlike the previous café dialogue reference.
